sources.topic: CNC bending service and process parameters

confirmed: The material catalog lists 5052 aluminum at 0.063 inch and indicates bending support.
Flat-cut parts use DXF; formed parts use STEP for supplier submission.
unverified: Bend radius and tooling constraints for this exact stock and supported feature ranges.
Minimum hole, slot, and feature-to-bend distances for every supported operation.
Maximum part envelope, tolerance, and upload acceptance for the generated files.
notes: Research baseline only. This profile is intentionally incomplete and does not establish manufacturing readiness.
